output.content:
**Equinix Q2 2026 snapshot:** Revenue was **$2.625 billion**, up **16% year over year** on both a reported and normalized constant-currency basis, with strong core performance and one-time **xScale** fees contributing to growth. [[1]]

- **AI demand:** Equinix said it expanded its Cisco and NVIDIA collaboration to help enterprises deploy AI through standardized AI-factory architectures, secure infrastructure and testing environments across its global data-center footprint. [[1]]
- **xScale:** The company closed **134 MW** of xScale leases in the quarter; the Hampton transaction accounted for approximately **$120 million** of fees. [[2]]
- **Interconnection revenue:** Q2 interconnection revenue was **$256 million**, versus $251 million in Q1 2026 and $231 million in Q2 2025. [[1]]
- **Annualized gross bookings:** Equinix delivered **$424 million**, up **23% year over year**, its second-highest quarterly volume on record and a contributor to record backlog. [[1]]
- **Net interconnections:** Equinix added a quarterly-record **9,700 net interconnections**, reinforcing the platform’s interconnection momentum. [[1]]
- **Underlying recurring growth:** Monthly recurring revenue increased **11% year over year** on both reported and normalized constant-currency bases, marking the third consecutive quarter of double-digit MRR growth. [[1]]
